answer: Every claim climbs the fable of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dune re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the thread of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
